species.name: Crappie
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 105 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 67°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.

East wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the west shore: try the wind-blown banks.
